title: Viral Bikes Opens Wanderer 32er Pre-Order
content:
Viral Bikes just rolled out its Wanderer 32er, along with a pre-order, but there are a few caveats…

John reviewed the Viral Derive hardtail in 2024. Read his review for an overview of the brand…

Wanderer 32er Complete Only

The new bike will only be available as a complete, AND only available in sizes V4 (large) and V5 (XL). There are a number of things that push the boundaries here in terms of geometry. Steve Domahidy, Viral’s founder, has some experience moving to a bigger wheel as co-founder and head of Niner’s R&D, and this experience and the subsequent progress of the 29er wheel have driven the decisions about this new geometry. “I see new 32er wheel bikes, and everybody seems to be making the same mistakes we made in the early days of the 29er wheel. The same mistakes I made,” Domahidy says. “Short chainstays and steeper head tube angles seem to be the general trend, and we found this to be useful in the early days of the 29er wheel, especially when the fork rakes were the same as 26er forks at 39 mm. It served us well in the transition of feel from the 26er wheel to the 29er wheel, but we’ve since found that the 29er can handle much longer chainstays and much slacker head tubes than any of us were willing to do when the new wheel size was so young. And I see the same things happening with this as well. We’ve played around quite a lot with the 32er geometry, and we’ve found what we landed on to be really amazing.”

Large and X-Large Only

The Wanderer keeps the same slack-ish head angle of the 29er version at 67.5 degrees and doesn’t shy away from a long chainstay length at 475 mm. “We realize this will give people pause, but the overall wheelbase of the 32er Wanderer is still shorter than the same size of the 29er wheel Dérive mountain bike. The 475 mm chainstay length is also combined with a BB drop of 108 mm (for the size V4), so the horizontal CS length will be shorter than this,” Domahidy continues. As for sizes, Viral also made the decision to only make the Wanderer 32er in size V4 and V5, and keep the 29er wheel versions of both for those that still want it. “We realize that serious bikepackers will be hesitant to jump on a 32er wheel with so few tire choices in the wild out there. It could really ruin a day to get a massive sidewall slash and have zero chance of finding a replacement tire.”

April 2027 Delivery

Viral also stuck with the Enve Mountain carbon fork as their fork of choice with a 490 mm axle to crown. This does bring the front end up a bit, but Viral believe it’s a bit of future proofing to ensure compatibility with suspension forks coming down the pipeline. “We could get the front end down by using a dedicated 32er front fork, but we believe that people will be slapping suspension forks on these in the very near future, and the extra crown-to-axle height will facilitate the swap without changing the geometry,” Domahidy says. With the pre- order, the Viral Wanderer 32er is available with either the Enve Mountain Fork or an 80mm Fox 34sl as a fork option. Pre-orders are open now, which lock you in to getting a frame in the first production run, scheduled for delivery in April 2027, and allow you to choose your own anodized color.

Check out the Wanderer 32er pre-order at Viral Bikes.
